import torch, json, importlib.util
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("kernel", "/root/cases/case_143/kernel.py")
k = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(k)
res = {}
for N in (32, 64, 128):
    g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(1234 + N)
    x = torch.randint(-32768, 32768, (5, N), generator=g, dtype=torch.int32).to("cuda", torch.int16)
    out = k.run(x); ref = k.reference(x)
    exact = torch.equal(out, ref)
    # how many coefficient positions match (identity permutation check)
    match_pos = int((out == ref).float().mean(dim=0).gt(0.9999).sum()) if not exact else N
    # is out a row-permutation of ref?
    perm_ok = any(torch.equal(out, ref[:, p]) for p in [None])
    res[f"N{N}"] = {"exact": exact, "rows_fully_matching_ref_positions": match_pos}
print(json.dumps(res))
", "expected_signal": "exact equality of run(x) and reference(x) for all N in {32,64,128}"}

import torch, json, importlib.util
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("kernel", "/root/cases/case_143/kernel.py")
k = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(k)
res = {}
for N in (32, 64, 128):
    g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(777 + N)
    x = torch.randint(-32768, 32768, (4, N), generator=g, dtype=torch.int32).to("cuda", torch.int16)
    out = k.run(x); ref = k.reference(x)
    # check negated / row-negated variants
    full_neg = torch.equal(out, -ref)                      # out == -ref entirely
    neg_rows = int(((out == -ref) & (ref != 0)).all(dim=1).sum())  # rows equal to negated ref
    exact = torch.equal(out, ref)
    # per-row sign agreement on nonzero coefficients
    nz = ref != 0
    sign_agree = bool((torch.sign(out[nz]) == torch.sign(ref[nz])).all())
    res[f"N{N}"] = {"exact": exact, "full_negation": full_neg, "fully_negated_rows": neg_rows, "sign_agreement_all": sign_agree}
print(json.dumps(res))
", "expected_signal": "out equals reference exactly with no negated rows or full negation"}

import torch, json, importlib.util
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("kernel", "/root/cases/case_143/kernel.py")

    x = torch.randint(-32768, 32768, (3, N), generator=g, dtype=torch.int32).to("cuda", torch.int16)
    out = k.run(x); ref = k.reference(x)
    # diagnostic: is out any permutation of ref's rows (row-set equality)?
    rows_ref = sorted(map(tuple, ref.tolist())); rows_out = sorted(map(tuple, out.tolist()))
    row_set_equal = rows_ref == rows_out
    # duplicate coefficient rows in out (sign of broken gather)?
    dup_rows = len(rows_out) != len(set(rows_out))
    # correctness per width
    exact = torch.equal(out, ref)
    res[f"N{N}"] = {"exact": exact, "rows_are_permutation_of_ref_rows": row_set_equal, "duplicate_rows_in_out": dup_rows}
print(json.dumps(res))
